description: The file exists and this process may not read it. Answering blank would let a later patch write a fresh document over settings that were only ever unreadable. PLATFORM: this state cannot be BUILT everywhere — chmod 000 is a no-op for root and only sets a read-only attribute on Windows, which still permits reading. A runner verifies it can deny itself the file and SKIPS with the reason when it cannot; it never passes the case.
notes: Divergence 1. Both runtimes refuse; rust was fixed red-first the same night.
